header.description: What: a horse standing on the farm lane stops a car (CE-3457; docs/designs/animals/DESIGN_Animals.md AR-17; Navigation v2 the CE-2059 rule's as-built). On the farm terrain a 'Horse' area (an ENCLOSED 6 x 6 m area on the lane at (100, 10) — its home keeps the horse within ~1.5 m of the centre) holds one war horse. A war horse is FEARLESS (it does not flee a vehicle), so it stays on the lane. A civilian car ('Car') drives east along the lane (y = 10) at 6 m/s toward (250, 10). The car YIELDS: it slows so it can stop 3 m short of an animal in its lane, stands there, and never touches it; the no-progress watchdog does not fail a vehicle standing for an animal. (A cow is the wrong animal for this test: measured, even a quiet car frightens cattle off the lane first — ua-animal-herd-road judges that.) Judge: (1) the horse is on the lane (2) the car gets under way (3) then the car stands (4) it stops short of the horse (its centre never past x 96 before it stands — the horse at ~99) (5) the horse is never hurt. When the horse grazes ~2 m off the lane's line the car drives past it (as measured: it waits ~35 s). Check: scripts/scenario-regression.sh ua-animal-horse-blocks-car
